title: 7.14. Hīnattika
note: Pāli only: every English translation of the Abhidhamma is still under copyright, so no English can be shown yet. A free translation will be added if one becomes available.

verses.t: Nahīnaṁ dhammaṁ paṭicca …pe… namajjhimaṁ dhammaṁ paṭicca …pe… napaṇītaṁ dhammaṁ paṭicca …. (Saṅkhittaṁ.)
Hetuyā ekūnatiṁsa, ārammaṇe catuvīsa …pe… vipāke ekavīsa …pe… avigate ekūnatiṁsa.
